issues.title: Authoritative spec DECIDES no gearbox/direct drive, but the live Phase-15 result set concludes the gearbox is mandatory
issues.evidence: Design spec Â§1 item 2: 'DECIDED - no gearbox ... Direct drive with a tuned-Kv rewind'; Â§11 'why direct drive'. But phase15_robu_final_config.json: 'direct drive is impossible inside the drone-arm RPM limits ... so the gearbox is mandatory' and report: 'The gearbox is mandatory ... the 2.35-2.95:1 reduction stays.'
issues.why_it_matters: The powertrain architecture, rotor speed, bearing/containment loads and mass (0.72 kg) all depend on which is true; the two authoritative documents cannot both be built.
issues.fix: Reconcile the decision in one place: either reinstate the gearbox everywhere or delete the drone-arm mechanical-rpm gate and prove 36-47 krpm direct drive.

decision_options.option: Reinstate geared drive (2.35-2.95:1) and accept ~5% loss and ~0.72 kg
decision_options.pros: Complies with drone-arm RPM contract and uses existing proven EDF hardware
decision_options.cons: Adds mass, loss, a single-point failure, and invalidates the direct-drive mass/cost ledger

decision_options.option: Keep direct drive and delete/raise the firmware mechanical-RPM limit
decision_options.pros: Removes gearbox mass and loss; matches the written DECISION
decision_options.cons: Requires 7-pole or 2-pole motor to survive 36-47 krpm and containment/bearing qualification; ESC firmware change is unproven

issues.title: ESC spec silently drops the drone-arm mechanical RPM limit that direct drive violates
issues.evidence: Spec Â§11 says the motor window 'tops out at 13.5-18 krpm' yet concludes a rewind enables direct 36-47 krpm; Â§12 ESC table lists only 'eRPM <=200,000' and no mechanical rpm limit. phase14 requires 'Motor speed soft rollback / hard shutdown 12,500 / 13,500 rpm' and provisional 18,000. Direct drive at 41,070 rpm exceeds 13,500/18,000 mechanically.
issues.why_it_matters: A rewind changes Kv, not the ESC's configured mechanical overspeed cut; the aircraft would trip its own governor, so the entire direct-drive premise is non-compliant.
issues.fix: State the mechanical rpm limit in Â§12 and either qualify the ESC above 47 krpm or revert to geared drive.

decision_options.option: Raise/re-validate the ESC mechanical rpm limit to >47,000
decision_options.cons: Needs firmware, sensorless-observability and overspeed-qualification evidence not yet obtained

decision_options.option: Keep the 12,500/13,500 rpm governor and use a gearbox
decision_options.cons: Reintroduces gearbox

issues.title: CdA gate has four mutually inconsistent definitions across the same authoritative set
issues.why_it_matters: CdA is declared gate #1 and directly scales cruise power and range (P ~ CdA); a 0.0008 vs 0.0030 spread is a 3.75x power/range swing.
issues.fix: Adopt one CdA definition/quantity (with a stated reference area) in Â§8, Â§20, Â§22 and OBSOLETE, and propagate it to all scripts.

decision_options.option: Accept the raster-model 0.000654-0.00080 m2
decision_options.cons: Requires the corrected side-by-side wing-inclusive geometry to be validated by VLM/CFD

decision_options.option: Accept the conservative 0.0015-0.0030 m2
decision_options.pros: Safer; matches the spec's own 'unresolved' flag
decision_options.cons: Range collapses to a few km and the 720 km/h mission may be infeasible

issues.title: Two live Phase-15 scripts use different CdA for the same 80 mm/40 mm front-inlet layout
issues.evidence: range/losses/reconciliation use CDA = 0.000654; low_cost_benchmark cda_for_fan(80) = 0.0009*59.52/69.14 = 0.0007748 (handoff 'cdaM2': 0.0007748) for the same 80 mm/40 mm front-inlet case.
issues.why_it_matters: An 18% CdA difference moves cruise power and the >=650 km/h gate, so the low-cost ranking and the range report are not comparable.
issues.fix: Have all Phase-15 scripts import one CdA/geometry function (the raster model) instead of hard-coded constants.

issues.title: Low-cost benchmark top-speed formula uses an unexplained 1.783 factor, giving a 720 km/h power of 16,962 W instead of 12,930 W
issues.evidence: REFERENCE_CRUISE_650_W=9513.5 and denominator '9513.5*1.783*cda/0.0009' = 16,962 W, while the calibrated 720 km/h bus power elsewhere is 12,930 W (ratio 9513.5*1.359=12,930).
issues.why_it_matters: Power-limited top speed scales as P^(1/3); the extra 1.31x understates vmax by ~9.5% and mis-fails the 'top_speed_ge_650' gate (e.g. 703.7 km/h would be reported as 675.6).
issues.fix: Replace 1.783 with 1.359 (12930/9513.5) or call the shared cruise-power function.

issues.title: Phase-9 reconciliation fails to reproduce Phase-9: text claims ~13 kW but its own phase9_basis row computes 7.9 kW
issues.evidence: Explanation: 'Phase-9 used inlet 0.98, nozzle 0.98, compressor eta 0.82, which lands at ~10 kW shaft / ~13 kW electrical'; the phase9_basis row gives 'shaft_power_w': 7024 and 'electrical_power_w': 7871.
issues.why_it_matters: The document's stated purpose is to reconcile 12.93 kW vs 3.9 kW, but its reference case is 7.9 kW, so the reconciliation does not close the discrepancy it claims to explain.
issues.fix: Force the model to reproduce the 12.93 kW point (e.g. include duct/exit losses or use measured recovery) or correct the narrative to 7.9 kW.

issues.title: Sprint range at 720 km/h stated as 3.4-7-11.2 km in one place and 4.1-9.1-16.7 km in another
issues.why_it_matters: The headline endurance/sprint number differs by ~50-140%, confusing mission planning and pack sizing.
issues.fix: Use the Â§3 table-derived values consistently in Â§2 and Â§23.

issues.evidence: Â§3 rows assume the low-CdA (0.000654) model to produce 4.8-5.8 kW; Â§8 declares CdA '0.0008 - 0.0015 - 0.0030'. Power scales with CdA, so at 0.0015-0.0030 the table's powers should rise ~2.3-4.6x.

issues.fix: Recompute the Â§3 table at the adopted CdA band, or state explicitly which CdA the table uses.

issues.fix: Reconcile to one body-solid definition and value.

issues.title: Wing aspect-ratio band is inconsistent with the independent span and area bands
issues.evidence: AR stated '1.30-1.50-1.80' (nominal = 0.52^2/0.19 = 1.42), but the span band 0.45-0.62 m with area band 0.13-0.30 m2 permits AR from 0.45^2/0.30 = 0.68 up to 0.62^2/0.13 = 2.96.
issues.why_it_matters: Induced drag scales 1/AR; a designer picking independently within the bands can be 2x off the stated AR target.
issues.fix: Constrain span, area and AR jointly in the table.

issues.title: Rotor minimum speed differs (33 vs 36 krpm) between Â§5, Â§11 and Â§23

issues.title: Control doc recommends 3 vanes (Option B, 6 servos) but Â§4, Â§11 register and the actuator count still say 4 vanes

issues.evidence: Â§9c 'Pick B ... That is 6 servos instead of 7'; but Â§4 'Count | 4 (UL, UR, LL, LR)', Â§11 'VANES 4x', and design spec Â§10 offers '(3 or 4) vector vanes'.

issues.evidence: Text: 'the roll inertia is ~5x smaller than previously used'; prior set given as '0.16/0.50/0.58'. 0.58/0.03 = 19.3x and 0.50/0.03 = 16.7x, not 5x.

issues.title: Battery feed gauge labelled '330 A aggregate' while the ESC bus limit is 360 A
issues.evidence: Â§15: 'Battery feed gauge ... 330 A aggregate'; Â§12: 'Aggregate current <=360 A (hard, 6 x 60 A)'.

issues.title: Burst per-channel current (75-105 A) is incompatible with the 360 A aggregate bus limit even with 'simultaneous burst' wording
issues.evidence: Table rows: 'Phase current, burst 75 - 90 - 105 A, <50 s' and 'Aggregate current <=360 A (hard, 6 x 60 A)'; 6 x 75 = 450 A, 6 x 105 = 630 A. The next row says no channel may exceed 60 A while others burst.
issues.why_it_matters: A burst command on multiple channels would blow the bus/fuse; the channel burst rating is unusable as written.
issues.fix: Either raise the bus limit and fuses to match burst, or cap burst current so the aggregate stays <=360 A.

decision_options.option: Keep 360 A bus; restrict burst aggregate to <=360 A
decision_options.cons: Effectively caps per-channel burst at 60 A average, removing the 90-105 A rating

decision_options.cons: Requires new busbar, fuse and pack wiring; battery pack must supply 450-630 A

issues.title: ESC burst phase current (90-105 A) is inconsistent with the 55-65 A per-motor battery fuses
issues.evidence: Burst 75-90-105 A phase; then 'Feed fuse rating 55 - 60 - 65 A each' and 'Practical battery current per motor 20 - 40 - 60 A'.
issues.why_it_matters: A burst that pushes >65 A of battery current per motor will open the fuse; phase vs battery current are being conflated without a stated conversion.
issues.fix: Publish the phase-to-battery current relationship and re-coordinate the fuses.

issues.title: Future pack reserve (2.6-3.2 kg) exceeds the 15% growth reserve (~1.1 kg) and the 8.5 kg hard ceiling
issues.evidence: Â§21: 'Mass reserve for future pack up to 2.2 - 2.6 - 3.2 kg'; Â§16 growth reserve max 1.11 kg and AUW hard ceiling 8.5 kg; Â§20b says 'CG/mass reserve to 2.6 kg'.

decision_options.cons: Rules out the 5-10 Ah packs the dual-mission claim relies on

issues.evidence: Â§14: 'Airframe core temp 30 - 45 - 55 C'; Â§17: 'PLA core service temp <= 45 - 50 - 55 C'; Â§20b 'PLA core (Tg 45-55 C)'; phase14 config 'airframeCoreTemperatureLimitC': 45.

decision_options.cons: May require more thermal shielding/bleed and CdA penalty

issues.evidence: Script hard-codes 'liion_prange_p50b_6s1p_5000_12c', 'liion_prange_nmc_6s2p_10000_3c', 'liion_samsung_6s2p_10000_9c'; phase15_sourcing.json contains no Li-ion pack (all 12S entries are LiPo).

issues.evidence: Â§13: 'Battery heat at 720 ... 559 - 1119 - 1678 W at 10.5 kW'; Â§14 only specifies 'airframe core 30-45-55 C', 'battery temp 20-40-55 C', 'cooling airflow 2-5-10% of duct flow' and 'bay vent 5-15-30 cm2' with no heat-removal calculation.

issues.evidence: Â§19 rows cover motors, battery, metal, composites, PLA, actuators only; Â§16 mass table includes 'ESC + flight PCBs 0.30-0.55 kg', 'Harness, connectors, fuses 0.15-0.40 kg', 'Landing gear 0.25-0.60 kg', 'Avionics 0.12-0.30 kg', 'Mounts 0.15-0.40 kg'; Â§3a bench rig is '5-15 k INR'.

issues.title: README calls requirements_r2 the 'active revision' while its own later text and OBSOLETE call it historical/obsolete
issues.evidence: README line 30-32: 'requirements_r2.yaml is the active revision'; README line 91: 'immutable r2 remains the historical baseline'; OBSOLETE: 'requirements/requirements.yaml, requirements_r2.yaml, requirements_r3_candidate.yaml OBSOLETE'.
issues.why_it_matters: The requirement authority is unclear, so which frontal-area/TWR gates apply is ambiguous.
issues.fix: Designate the design spec as the sole requirement authority and mark the YAML files historical.

issues.title: OBSOLETE calls phase14 optimization 'current', but the phase14 config/architecture is coaxial 90 mm, contradicting the side-by-side 80 mm decision
issues.evidence: OBSOLETE line 49: 'phase14/optimization/*.py current'; phase14 config: 'two coaxially projected 90mm EDF modules' and rotorOuterDiameterMm 90; design spec: 'Duct layout side-by-side ... NOT coaxial', OD 'hold 80'.
issues.why_it_matters: Running the 'current' phase14 scripts propagates the wrong duct count/layout/diameter.
issues.fix: Either update the phase14 config/scripts to the side-by-side 80 mm layout or downgrade them to superseded.

issues.title: Report Â§6 mixes a direct-drive motor with a gearbox in the same paragraph
issues.evidence: 'Rocket 3670 4-pole ... only 2 pole pairs ... Rewind to roughly 280-450 Kv for 12S; the ESC rpm governor then holds 12,500 rpm and the 2.9:1 gearbox produces the fan speed.' Yet the same report's banner and the design spec say the gearbox is deleted.
issues.why_it_matters: The recommended motor path is internally contradictory on architecture, so it cannot be actioned.
issues.fix: Rewrite Â§6 for one architecture (direct drive at fan rpm, or geared).

issues.title: Report's locked build uses a 90 mm fan while the design spec holds 80 mm
issues.evidence: Report: 'Rotor rows 3 per duct, 90 mm OD'; spec: 'Fan outer diameter 72 - 80 - 90 mm | hold 80'.
issues.why_it_matters: Fan diameter sets annulus area, TWR, tip Mach and eRPM; the two live documents disagree.
issues.fix: Align the report's locked build to 80 mm or state it as a superseded alternative.

issues.title: Report recommends moving the frontal-area requirement to 100-110 cm2 while the spec declares 242-296 cm2
issues.evidence: Report: 'the requirement itself must move to roughly 100-110 cm2'; spec: 'Frontal solid area (with wings) 242 - 270 - 296 cm2'.
issues.why_it_matters: A 100-110 cm2 gate would reject the design the spec calls correct; the two documents define different aircraft.
issues.fix: Adopt the corrected raster-area gate (~240-300 cm2) and delete the 100-110 recommendation (which came from the old coaxial union model).

decision_options.option: Adopt ~240-300 cm2 gate (side-by-side raster)
decision_options.cons: Requires higher thrust/power and re-baselining CdA

decision_options.option: Keep a ~110 cm2 gate
decision_options.cons: Not achievable with two side-by-side ducts plus batteries; forces a coaxial/single-duct redesign

issues.title: Typos: 'dorne-arm' in the phase14 scale analysis
issues.evidence: 'Keeping the six-channel dorne-arm board' and 'the dorne-arm 200 keRPM ESC contract' (should be drone-arm).
issues.why_it_matters: Minor, but a repeated misspelling of a key hardware dependency.
issues.fix: Correct to 'drone-arm'.

issues.title: CdA remains unmeasured yet drives every power/range claim
issues.evidence: Â§8: 'CdA at 720 (UNRESOLVED - #1 gate)'; Â§22 requires 'VLM/CFD + tunnel'; report: 'it needs a fresh VLM/CFD-derived polar rather than an assumed number'.
issues.why_it_matters: Power at 720 scales linearly with CdA; until measured, the 720 km/h / 116 km mission is unproven at a 3-4x spread.
issues.fix: Gate all range/speed claims on a measured CdA and mark the current numbers as provisional.

issues.title: No flutter analysis exists; only flutter margins are asserted
files: design/PHASE15_CONTROL_SURFACES.md Â§3 line 107, Â§4 line 130, Â§9b line 368
issues.evidence: Flutter margins are specified ('>=1.2 - 1.4 - 2.0x Vd', '>=1.5 - 2.0 - 3.0x Vd') and the test plan requires 'no divergence <=720 km/h eq', but no analysis (mass balance, hinge stiffness, V-g) is reported.
issues.why_it_matters: At 720 km/h and 0.5 tip Mach, control-surface and fin flutter is a flight-safety gate; a margin without analysis is not evidence.
issues.fix: Run a flutter/V-g analysis and ground-vibration test before flight.

issues.title: No rotor/bearing/hub qualification or containment evidence at 41-47 krpm
issues.evidence: Gates require 'Rotor containment 1.25x 41 krpm', 'Direct-drive rotor rating 36-47 krpm', and centrifugal FOS 3.0-4.5-6.0, but no spin-pit, balancing or bearing-life analysis is present; the report and phase15 configs only state the requirement.
issues.why_it_matters: A metal blade liberated at 41 krpm is a containment event; without a test plan/cost the build cannot be safely released.
issues.fix: Add an overspeed/spin-pit and bearing-life test plan with budget.

issues.title: No qualified direct-drive 2-pole-pair 12S high-speed motor has been identified
issues.evidence: Spec demands '2 MANDATORY'; the only 2-pole-pair candidates are 6S-rated (Rocket 3670 4-pole 6S, Spektrum 4-pole 6S) and 227-290 g vs the spec's 120-280 g; the report's chosen Rocket is '4-6S' and 0.29 kg.
issues.why_it_matters: Direct drive depends on a motor that does not exist in the sourced inventory; the mass/thermal assumptions are unverified.
issues.fix: Either source/quote a 12S 2-pole-pair high-speed inrunner or revert to the geared FA4119.

decision_options.option: Commit to rewrite/qualify a 2-pole-pair inrunner
decision_options.pros: Meets the spec and avoids gearing
decision_options.cons: No sourced part; needs rewind + dyno + thermal proof

decision_options.option: Use a 7-pole-pair geared FA4119
decision_options.cons: Reintroduces the gearbox and ~0.72 kg

issues.title: Tip Mach 0.70 is unreachable within the 47 krpm band at 80 mm
issues.evidence: 80 mm at 47 krpm gives tip speed pi*0.08*47000/60 = 196.7 m/s; at 3 km a=328.6 m/s so Mach = 0.60, not 0.70. Mach 0.70 needs ~55 krpm at 80 mm.
issues.why_it_matters: The flutter/compressibility screening uses a max tip Mach the hardware cannot produce within the stated rpm band (or the rpm band is too low).
issues.fix: Set the max tip Mach to the achievable 0.60 at 80 mm/47 krpm, or raise the rpm band.

issues.title: Report claims 'no 12S inrunner exists on amazon.in' but its own dataset contains 12S inrunners
issues.evidence: Report: 'No 12S EDF unit and no 12S inrunner exists on amazon.in at all'; dataset lists Castle 2028-800Kv '3S-12S 4-pole' and MAD 5015 '6-12S'.
issues.why_it_matters: The sourcing conclusion is overstated relative to the data, weakening the 'no in-budget motor' argument.
issues.fix: Restate as 'no affordable 12S inrunner' with the exceptions noted.

issues.title: Thrust-stand and CG mass bases use 6.4-8.5 kg, not the spec's 4.3-8.5 kg
issues.evidence: 'static thrust is 82-176 N at TWR 1.3-2.1' requires 6.4-8.5 kg (6.4*9.807*1.3=81.6, 8.5*9.807*2.1=175.1); the spec AUW band is 4.3-8.5 kg, whose min gives 54.8 N.
issues.why_it_matters: The instrument range omits the low-mass corner and is labelled with a mass basis not used elsewhere.
issues.fix: Use the spec AUW band (or state the basis).

issues.title: Same report gives two different frontal areas for the same aircraft (0.01255 m2 vs 0.0009 m2 scale)
issues.evidence: High-cost evaluation 'frontalAreaM2': 0.01255 (125.5 cm2); report Â§3b corrected raster says 80 mm side = 296.2 cm2 and 80 mm front = 242.2 cm2; report Â§3 text also says '~106 cm2'.
issues.why_it_matters: The workbench optimiser (125.5 cm2) and the corrected model (242-296 cm2) differ by 2.0-2.4x; the 'infeasible design' conclusion may be an artefact of the wrong area model.
issues.fix: Re-run the high-cost benchmark with the corrected side-by-side raster area model.

issues.title: Pole-pair requirement stated three ways: '2 MANDATORY', '2 OR 4', and '<=4'
issues.evidence: Â§11: 'Pole pairs | 2 MANDATORY'; Â§1: 'Pole count must stay <=4 pole pairs'; Â§23: '2 OR 4 pole pairs (discrete)'; README/OBSOLETE: 'rewound 4-pole inrunner' (=2 pole pairs).
issues.why_it_matters: Pole count fixes eRPM, iron loss and motor sourcing; the requirement must be unambiguous.
issues.fix: State one rule (e.g. '2 pole pairs preferred; 4 pole pairs allowed with 6% eRPM margin').

issues.title: Unused constants in the frontal-area model
issues.evidence: CONTROL_W_MM = 200.0 and CONTROL_THICK_MM = 10.0 are defined but never referenced (the code marks controls only as part of wing/tail).
issues.why_it_matters: The docstring claims control surfaces contribute area, but the model does not compute them, hiding whether the claim is true.
issues.fix: Remove the dead code or actually model the control-surface strip.

issues.title: Phase-15 report section order is broken (section 4 after sections 5 and 6)
issues.evidence: Headings run 1, 2, 3, 3b, 5, 6, 4 ('## 4. What this means' appears at line 237).
issues.why_it_matters: Readers following the conclusions out of order can pair the 'no in-budget powertrain' conclusion with the superseded geared section.
issues.fix: Renumber sections in reading order.

issues.title: Rule of thumb 'every -0.01 recovery ~ +1.5-2 kW' understates the reconciliation's own sensitivity (~2.5 kW)
issues.evidence: Spec: 'every -0.01 ~ +1.5-2 kW'; reconciliation phase9_basis (0.98, 0.82) = 7,871 W vs good_inlet (0.99, 0.86) = 5,323 W, a 2,548 W change for 0.01 recovery.
issues.why_it_matters: Understates the cost of inlet loss, which the document calls the #1 driver.
issues.fix: Update the sensitivity figure to ~2.5 kW per 0.01.

issues.title: Control doc's derived low-speed deflection band (20-25-32 deg) is inconsistent with the elevon and vane limits
issues.evidence: Â§2 derived: 'Max deflection, low speed 20 - 25 - 32 deg'; Â§3 elevon: '+/-12 - 25 - 35 deg'; Â§4 vane: '+/-15 - 22 - 35 deg'.
issues.why_it_matters: The derived requirement is neither an upper nor lower bound of the effector limits, so the authority map (computed at 20 deg) is inconsistent with the effectors.
issues.fix: Define the low-speed limit per surface family and recompute the authority map.

issues.title: Vane jet-load test band does not match the vane hinge-moment spec
issues.evidence: Â§10: 'Vane jet-load 0.03 - 0.15 - 0.4 N-m'; Â§4: 'Vane hinge moment 0.03 - 0.09 - 0.25 N-m'.
issues.why_it_matters: Servo sizing depends on the peak load; the test acceptance band's 0.4 N-m exceeds the design estimate by 60%.
issues.fix: Make the test band and the design estimate consistent, or note the test band is a margin envelope.

issues.title: Gyroscopic and rotating-imbalance loads from six rotors at 33-47 krpm are not analysed
issues.evidence: Six metal rotors at 41 krpm on an airframe with pitch/yaw inertia 0.15-0.35 kg*m2; the spec lists vibration instrumentation ('0-5-20 g rms') but no gyroscopic moment, rotor imbalance, or whirl analysis anywhere.
issues.why_it_matters: At 41 krpm the angular momentum of six rotors creates significant pitch/yaw coupling and bearing loads not captured by the 'uniform-body estimate' inertia.
issues.fix: Add a gyroscopic/rotordynamic load case and hub-bearing life check.
